title: UAAP: UST girls stay perfect, FEU-D boys take control in high school chess

blocks.text: University of Santo Tomas maintained its perfect run in the girls' division after sweeping De La Salle Zobel, 4-0, while Far Eastern University-Diliman seized solo control of the boys' division in Round 4 of the UAAP Season 89 High School Chess Championships on Sunday at the BGPOP Building.
